statement: Let ρ be a nondegenerate mean-zero law supported on [−1, 1]. There are constants A, B, D, c > 0, a fixed cutoff H, and ε0(ρ) ∈ (0, 1) with the following property. For each 0 < ε < ε0(ρ), there are positive deterministic physical inverse temperatures βp = K0 + Oρ(ε2 ), βd = K0 + Oρ(ε2 ) (3.8) such that the primal array at βp and the dual array at βd have, at the common spacings sk = s0Lk, vk := vH,k > 0, Xk ≤ A √ vk, Yk ≤ Bvk, |mk| ≤ Dvk, (3.9) and vk ≤ 1 v−1 0 + ck . (3.10) In particular, Xk → 0 for both arrays. Given any η > 0, the same choices can be made with supk Xk ≤ η by decreasing ε0(ρ). All choices precede the specification of a domain or its lattice approximations.
